title: Student V0.1 JOB 07 R2 — deterministic pilot packaging with canonical generated qualification kit

rejectedQualificationFixture.reason: runtime fixture is structurally rich but its lesson body fails current canonical V4 authoring admissibility

purpose: Complete pilot packaging qualification around the exact repaired product using a canonical ephemeral rich-V4 qualification kit generated from the repository's frozen canonical V4 representative generator, without mutating product, validator, runtime fixture, generator, or showcase content.
invariants: JOB07 R2 starts cleanly from the repaired-product evidence head, not from the failed JOB07 R1 branch.
The failed R1 runtime fixture remains unchanged; its failure is qualification-input evidence, not repair authority.
The canonical qualification kit is generated ephemerally from exact authoring/v4/tests/test_validate_v4.py blob 85debca78c3ec342d9e4e7ed63a033fd0968e72e using make_valid_v4().
The generated qualification kit must be deterministically serialized, canonically validated, hashed, and used unchanged for all package/browser qualification steps.
The pilot package builder itself is generic over arbitrary canonical learnit.kit.v4 input and has no runtime dependency on authoring test helpers.
The repaired product is read-only and must remain byte-identical to the accepted served-V4 artifact.
No JOB06 showcase file is consumed; showcase remains frozen for later fan-in.
JOB05 R1 is a prerequisite gate only; no QA implementation file is consumed.
The package is local/offline, deterministic, hash-bound and contains no required remote dependency.
Learner action count must include mandatory browser chooser/selection/import steps honestly.
No auto-import, browser-security bypass, product fork, backend, service dependency or new product persistence model is introduced.
Any product defect discovered during packaged use returns HOLD; pilot scope never repairs it.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP/repository/PR #411 rebind and durable verification of accepted JOB05 R1 PASS.
Exact ancestry from JOB07_R2_BASE and repaired product anchor.
Exact canonical generator blob identity 85debca78c3ec342d9e4e7ed63a033fd0968e72e is rechecked before qualification input generation.
Representative canonical generator test passes unchanged.
Ephemeral qualification kit is materialized from make_valid_v4(), deterministically serialized, and its byte count/SHA256 recorded.
Canonical V4 validator passes on the exact materialized qualification kit before packaging.
Generated qualification kit contains all eight Student V0.1 families and safe local SVG media.
Canonical repaired app built twice and verified at 478657 bytes / SHA256 85dbeeef4207c9e4deb846d2b2e15f1e6979b1d32144ead3c1097bd5bf15630e.
Old served-session blocker closure is re-proved on the generated qualification kit before package implementation proceeds.
A generic deterministic package builder accepts explicit app HTML and canonical V4 kit paths.
Package manifest binds exact app and kit filenames, bytes, SHA256 and package schema/version.
START_HERE is deterministic, local-only, learner-facing and does not silently bypass file selection.
Two package builds from identical inputs are byte-identical; archive entry names/order/timestamps/permissions/compression metadata are inspected.
Extracted app and kit bytes exactly match manifest-bound inputs.
Direct-file behavior is tested first; if unusable, any loopback helper is standard-library-only, binds 127.0.0.1, and is explicitly facilitator tooling.
The actual documented start mode is used for browser qualification.
Actual learner action count from START_HERE to course start is recorded without omitting chooser/selection/import actions.
Extracted package is used for the real rich-V4 journey; source-tree product is not substituted for package proof.
Desktop 1365x768 and mobile 390x844 both complete import/start/rich interaction/reload/resume/completion.
No unexpected external HTTP(S) requests occur through start, media, reload/resume or completion.
Packaged learner runtime/presentation/DOM exposes none of correctChoiceId, answers, acceptedResponses, matches, correctOrder, assignments.
Recovery covers invalid kit selection, retry, library return/continue and local reset/re-import without claiming cloud/account recovery.
Relevant served-repair regressions rerun unchanged on exact RESULT_SHA.
Exact-head CI proves package determinism, packaged browser journey and repaired-product regressions.
Repository governance, authoritative PR scope and exact changed-path scope pass.
Qualification evidence separates RESULT_SHA from later evidence-only EVIDENCE_HEAD.
adversarialTests: Changing or weakening the runtime fixture, canonical generator, canonical validator or authoring code to obtain a qualification input is a scope failure.
A generated qualification kit that has not passed the canonical validator cannot be used for packaging.
A package builder that imports make_valid_v4() at runtime is invalid; generator dependency is qualification-only.
A package that embeds app bytes differing from the repaired artifact is a failure.
A deterministic archive without a real packaged learner journey cannot PASS.
A manifest binding only names and not bytes/hashes is a failure.
Generated ZIP timestamps/order/permissions that vary across identical runs are a failure.
Testing source-tree Learn-it while claiming extracted-package PASS is forbidden.
Qualifying under loopback while documenting direct-file-only start is forbidden.
A remote network request required for any learner step is a failure.
Changing product code or auto-importing the kit to lower learner action count is a scope failure.
Using frozen JOB06 showcase content as qualification input is forbidden in R2.
If packaged use reveals a product defect, return HOLD_PRODUCT_BLOCKS_PILOT rather than patching it.
nonGoals: Changing canonical V4 authoring policy or validators.
independentReview: R1's HOLD is accepted as an input-authority defect, not a product failure.
R2 corrects only the qualification input authority and then re-executes the packaging mission from the repaired product base.
Generated qualification input identity and validation are durable evidence; no silent substitution is permitted.
G3 remains a separate Control Room review after R2.
rollback: Close the JOB07 R2 PR and delete its branch. PR #411, repaired product/evidence anchors, accepted JOB05 R1, frozen JOB06, and historical JOB07 R1 remain unchanged.
